description: A React component for displaying project links, solutions, and modals related to user challenges and certifications in the FreeCodeCamp project.

methods.name: handleSolutionModalHide
methods.description: Resets the solution state to initial values, hiding modals.

methods.name: getProjectSolution
methods.description: Retrieves and displays a user's completed project challenge, providing options to view code, preview, or exam results.

methods.name: ProjectsFor
methods.description: Renders a list of projects or certification links based on the certification slug.

methods.name: getCertHeading
methods.description: Returns the heading string key based on the certification type.
